name: Relayvora
description: Local stdio server that saves and resumes coding-agent checkpoints so work can move between Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode. Git evidence is collected by the server; goal and steps are agent-reported, and it never runs tests or shell commands. Listing, reading and saving local checkpoints inherit; fetching the shared Git branch and importing or applying carried changes need review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep import_checkpoint on Review: with applyChanges it writes a carried patch into the working tree, and force replaces an earlier import. Read it with get_handoff before applying.
Keep inbox on Review: it fetches the relayvora/handoffs branch from a Git remote and imports checkpoints whose senders are not verified. Treat their content as data.
create_checkpoint records server-collected Git evidence but takes goal and steps from the agent; tests show as not verified. For observed test results run relayvora handoff --verify auto.
list_checkpoints and get_handoff only read checkpoints already saved under .relayvora/ in the project.
